wsdl:operation.name: GetIDOLTariffsForPurchase
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: Returns active/valid IDOL tariffs for specified parameters.

wsdl:operation.name: GetIDOLCustomerTariffsForPurchase
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: Returns active/valid IDOL tariffs for specified company and customer.

wsdl:operation.name: AddIDOLItemToOrder
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method adds coupon to order and returns result. If the OrderID parameter is empty then store a new order and add specified coupon to this order (for the first order coupon).

wsdl:operation.name: GetIDOLTokenTariffs
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method returns list of IDOL tariffs for specified token and start date.

wsdl:operation.name: SaveIDOLTicketItems
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: Save collection of IDOL ticket items

wsdl:operation.name: GetIDOLLatestTicketItem
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: Get latest IDOL ticket item

wsdl:operation.name: SignECDSA
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method signs provided ETD in HEX format and returns signed ETD. Parameter EtdStringToSign is mandatory.

wsdl:operation.name: GetValueFromKeyValueStorage
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: Returns value from KeyValue storage. If value not found, then ReturnCode.Error is returned.

wsdl:operation.name: SaveToKeyValueStorage
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: Save key and value to custom KeyValue storage for current ApiKey.

wsdl:operation.name: CreateLogin
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method creates a new login and returns result.

wsdl:operation.name: SendEmail
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method sends e-mail (contains Subject and Body) and returns result and supports HTML email formating via parameter BodyIsHtml

wsdl:operation.name: ActivateLogin
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method sets login as active (LoginID OR UserName must be specified) and returns result.

wsdl:operation.name: DeactivateLoginAndRelatedCustomers
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method deactivates login and all Self and Child customers if they haven't any assigned coupon. Password parameter is not required for some specific service keys.

wsdl:operation.name: AuthenticateLogin
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method checks the login and specified password. If everything is passed then returns OK. Session object is created.

wsdl:operation.name: IsSessionAlive
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method will check if login session exists and is still alive. If session is found, it's refreshed.

wsdl:operation.name: AuthenticateLoginByToken
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method checks the token and creates a session for related login. If the token has not customer or login, some service account is created automatically.The token is then assigned to the customer service account. Only some service keys are allow to use this method.

wsdl:operation.name: CheckUserName
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method checks if the user name (e-mail) already exists. if LoginID=-1 then login does not exist. If everything is passed then returns OK.

wsdl:operation.name: ChangePassword
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method will check current login and password. If everything is OK then current password is changed and the method returns result.

wsdl:operation.name: CreateNewPassword
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method will reset password (situation when the user forgot his password) for specified login and returns result.

wsdl:operation.name: Logout
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method will end session for specified user.

wsdl:operation.name: GetLoginMarketingInfo
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method loads marketing info for specified login.

wsdl:operation.name: SetLoginMarketingInfo
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method sets approval for marketing info for specified login.

wsdl:operation.name: SetInactiveLoginMarketingInfo
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method sets approval for marketing info for specified login. Specified Login must be inactive.

wsdl:operation.name: CreateSelfCustomer
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method creates a self customer and returns result with customer ID. Parameter DisplayName is mandatory.

wsdl:operation.name: CreateCustomer
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method creates a customer and returns result with customer ID. Parameter DisplayName is mandatory.

wsdl:operation.name: ChangeCustomer
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method updates customer information and returns result with customer ID. If Customer's PUK is not empty then PUK will be updated. If Customer's ISIC number is not empty and is valid, then customer discount will be stored.

wsdl:operation.name: CreateChildCustomer
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method creates child account and returns result with child customer ID. Parameters ChildDisplayName, FirstName, MiddleName, LastName and DateOfBirth are mandatory.

wsdl:operation.name: ChangeChildCustomer
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method changes child account properties and returns result.

wsdl:operation.name: DeleteChildCustomer
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method removes child customer and returns result.

wsdl:operation.name: ChangeChildCustomerToSelf
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method transfers child customer to self customer with own login and returns result with new self Login ID. Parameters DisplayName and Email are mandatory.

wsdl:operation.name: ChangeEmail
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method changes email of current login. Password parameter is not required for some specific service keys.

wsdl:operation.name: GetCustomers
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method gets customer list (my customers) and returns result.

wsdl:operation.name: GetCustomersWhoCanManageMe
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method gets customer list (logins) who can manage my account and returns result.

wsdl:operation.name: GetCustomerInfo
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method returns customer information for specified login and returns result.

wsdl:operation.name: GetPhoto
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method returns customer's photos (color and B&W) and returns result.

wsdl:operation.name: UpdatePhoto
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method updates customer's photo (color and B&W) and returns result.

wsdl:operation.name: UpdatePhotoWithWebP
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method updates customer's photo (color, B&W and WebP) and returns result.

wsdl:operation.name: UpdatePhotoWebP
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method updates customer's WebP photo from B&W photo and returns result.

wsdl:operation.name: ConfirmBirthDate
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method saves and confirms customer date of birth.

wsdl:operation.name: GetAddressInfo
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method returns customer's address (mail OR visit) and returns result.

wsdl:operation.name: CreateCustomerAddress
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method creates an address and returns result with Address ID.

wsdl:operation.name: ChangeCustomerAddress
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method changes an address and returns result with Address ID.

wsdl:operation.name: RemoveCustomerAddress
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method removes an address and returns result.

wsdl:operation.name: SetCustomerPersonalDataConsent
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method sets customer consent with processing personal data.

wsdl:operation.name: GetCustomerPersonalDataConsent
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method gets customer consent with processing personal data.

wsdl:operation.name: RemoveCustomerPersonalDataConsent
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method removes customer consent with processing personal data.

wsdl:operation.name: GetDiscountTypes
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method returns discount types and returns result.

wsdl:operation.name: GetCustomerDiscounts
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method returns customer's discounts and returns result.

wsdl:operation.name: CreateCustomerDiscount
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method creates a customer discount and returns result with CustomerDiscount ID.

wsdl:operation.name: RemoveCustomerDiscount
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method removes the customer discount and returns result.

wsdl:operation.name: AddCustomerManager
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method creates a new unconfirmed customer manager and returns result. Current account offers other login to take control.

wsdl:operation.name: ConfirmCustomerManager
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method confirms customer manager and returns result. Current login confirms that he/she would like to be customer manager.

wsdl:operation.name: RemoveCustomerManager
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method removes a customer manager and returns result. The logged-in user wants to remove specified another customer manager.

wsdl:operation.name: RemoveThisLoginFromCustomerManagers
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method removes a customer manager and returns result. The logged-in user (customer manager) wants to remove of himself/herself from existing customer.

wsdl:operation.name: GetTokens
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method returns list of tokens (identifiers) for specified login.

wsdl:operation.name: GetTokenTariffs
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method returns list of tariffs for specified token and start date.

wsdl:operation.name: ChangeTokenName
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method changes name of token and returns result. Token must be related to the specified customer (login's customer) and name is mandatory.

wsdl:operation.name: ChangeActiveToken
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method activate/inactivate token and returns result.

wsdl:operation.name: BlockToken
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method sets token block status as Blocked by API and inactivates token.

wsdl:operation.name: AssignToken
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method assigns a token(s) to specified customer and returns result.

wsdl:operation.name: RemoveToken
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method removes specified token from the customer and returns result. TokenID and CustomerID is mandatory. Specified token can be active or inactive.

wsdl:operation.name: DeleteToken
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method deletes specified token from the database and Tokenizer and returns result. TokenID is mandatory. Specified token cannot be blocked by admin and must not have assigned any valid coupons.

wsdl:operation.name: MoveCouponFromToken
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method transfers coupon/coupons from one token to another and returns result.

wsdl:operation.name: AssignCouponToToken
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method assigns a coupon to specified token and returns result.

wsdl:operation.name: SetTokenIsPersonalized
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method sets IsPersonalized property of the token (only for anonymous tokens). Token type must be 'BPK' or 'MobApp'. This value CANNOT be changed later.

wsdl:operation.name: SetTokenActive
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method sets the token as active for current transport system. Token must be personalized. All active non-transferable coupons from other personalized tokens will be moved to this token.

wsdl:operation.name: InitiateTokenRegistration
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method initiates a new Token registration by calling the Tokenizer service. Returns a call Result, and details of the Token registration initiation, ie. RegistrationID generated by the Tokenizer service, and a URL to be used to redirect the customer's browser to the Tokenization gateway. The caller must pass an URL pointing to the e-shop; will be used by the Tokenization gateway to redirect the customer's browser back to the e-shop

wsdl:operation.name: GetTokenRegistrationState
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method obtains the Registration state of the provided token by calling the Tokenizer service. Returns a call Result, and details of the Token registration state, ie. registration state, type of the identifier, and a list of tokens in case the tokenization has already been completed. The caller must pass a valid Registration ID provided by the Tokenizer service in the result of the InitiateTokenRegistration method.

wsdl:operation.name: VerifyToken
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method re-verifies the specified Token calling the Tokenizer service. Returns a call Result, and result of the Token verification. The caller must pass a valid Token. If the response from the tokenizer is that the token is expired, blacklisted, not valid, lost or stolen, the token is then blocked in the DB.

wsdl:operation.name: GetCoupons
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method returns list of coupons (tickets).

wsdl:operation.name: GetIDOLCoupons
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method returns list of IDOL coupons (tickets).

wsdl:operation.name: GetCustomTerminationReasons
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method returns coupon custom termination reasons.

wsdl:operation.name: TerminateCoupon
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method terminates coupon.

wsdl:operation.name: ReturnCoupon
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method cancels Valid or BeforeValid Coupon. Only some service keys are allow to use this method.

wsdl:operation.name: GetOrders
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method returns list of orders according to the parameters. Parameter OrderID is optional.

wsdl:operation.name: CancelOrder
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method sets existing order to cancelled order and returns result.

wsdl:operation.name: UncancelOrder
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method sets existing cancelled order to order with status Ordered and returns result.

wsdl:operation.name: UnlockOrder
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method sets existing locked order to order with status Ordered, deletes payment gateway reference and returns result.

wsdl:operation.name: GetOrderCoupons
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method returns order coupons and returns result.

wsdl:operation.name: GetIDOLOrderCoupons
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method returns IDOL order coupons and returns result.

wsdl:operation.name: AddItemToOrder
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method adds coupon to order and returns result. If the OrderID parameter is empty then store a new order and add specified coupon to this order (for the first order coupon).

wsdl:operation.name: DeleteItemFromOrder
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method deletes item (coupon) from order and returns result.

wsdl:operation.name: ChangeOrderPaymentType
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method changes order payment type and returns result.

wsdl:operation.name: SetOrderPaid
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method sets order as paid for customers who buy a ticket directly in office OR in e-shop and returns result.

wsdl:operation.name: ChangeOrderReceiptDetails
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method changes order additional info required for tax receipts and returns result.

wsdl:operation.name: GetReceiptPdf
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method returns receipt PDF file and returns result.

wsdl:operation.name: ConfirmOrderPurchase
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method validates order and coupons, customer discounts validity, confirms order and returns result. Currently used only for orders paid by bank transfer.

wsdl:operation.name: InitiateOrderPayment
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method initiates a order payment. Returns a result with bank gateway URL which will be used to redirect the customer's browser to the payment gateway.The gateway supported more languages according to the parameter language CZ (Czech), CS(Czech), EN(English), DE(German), RU(Russian), ZH (Chinese).

wsdl:operation.name: ProcessPaymentGatewayResult
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method checks the payment result (previously, the payment has initiated by method InitiateOrderPayment) and marks coupon as purchased.

wsdl:operation.name: InitiateOrderPaymentV19
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method initiates a order payment. Returns a result with bank gateway URL which will be used to redirect the customer's browser to the payment gateway.The gateway supported more languages according to the parameter language CZ (Czech), CS(Czech), EN(English), DE(German), RU(Russian), ZH (Chinese).

wsdl:operation.name: InitiateOrderPaymentWithTokenCustomerPresent
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: Initiates payment of the specified Order using Token.

wsdl:operation.name: ProcessOrderPaymentWithTokenCustomerPresent
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: Processes payment of the specified Order using Token.

wsdl:operation.name: InitiateOrderPaymentApplePay
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: Initiates payment of the specified Order using ApplePay.

wsdl:operation.name: ProcessOrderPaymentApplePay
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: Processes payment of the specified Order using ApplePay.

wsdl:operation.name: InitiateOrderPaymentGooglePay
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: Initiates payment of the specified Order using GooglePay.

wsdl:operation.name: ProcessOrderPaymentGooglePay
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: Processes payment of the specified Order using GooglePay.

wsdl:operation.name: InitiateOrderPaymentConfirmo
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: Initiates payment of the specified Order using Confirmo (crypto payment). Available only for IDOL. After successful initiation, the customer should be redirected to the PaymentURL.

wsdl:operation.name: ProcessPaymentGatewayResultV19
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method checks the payment result (previously, the payment has initiated by method InitiateOrderPaymentV19) and marks coupon as purchased.

wsdl:operation.name: GetCompanies
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: Returns active/valid companies.

wsdl:operation.name: GetDurationTypes
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: Returns duration types.

wsdl:operation.name: GetCustomerProfiles
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: Returns active/valid customer profiles. Only some service keys are allow to use this method.

wsdl:operation.name: GetCustomerProfilesForDistributionChannel
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: Returns active/valid customer profiles for specified application/distribution channel.

wsdl:operation.name: GetCustomerProfilesForCustomer
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: Returns active customer profiles for specified customer and returns result

wsdl:operation.name: SetCustomerProfiles
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: Sets customer profiles for specified customer and returns result. Name of new customer profiles is not needed. Only some service keys are allow to use this method.

wsdl:operation.name: GetTariffProfiles
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: Returns active/valid tariff profiles.

wsdl:operation.name: GetTariffs
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: Returns active/valid tariffs for specified parameters.

wsdl:operation.name: GetTariffsForPurchase
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: Returns active/valid tariffs for specified company and customer.

wsdl:operation.name: GetTariffPrice
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: Returns price for specified tariff and zones.

wsdl:operation.name: StoreClaim
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method stores a new claim and requires email address filled in.

wsdl:operation.name: GetSettings
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: Returns common settings.

wsdl:operation.name: VerifyCard
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: Verify card ISIC, ITIC, IYTC and ALIVE

wsdl:operation.name: SaveTicketItems
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: Save collection of ticket items

wsdl:operation.name: GetLatestTicketItem
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: Get latest ticket item

wsdl:operation.name: GetNotificationRules
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method returns current notification rules for specified login and returns result.

wsdl:operation.name: SetNotifications
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method sets current notification for login and returns result.

wsdl:operation.name: SendSMS
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method send SMS to specified phone number

wsdl:operation.name: NotificationAccountRegistration
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method sends notification of Registration of new account

wsdl:operation.name: NotificationRegistrationFinished
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method sets notification of Registration of new account finished

wsdl:operation.name: NotificationForgottenPassword
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method sends notification when user forgot the password

wsdl:operation.name: NotificationPasswordChangeConfirmation
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method sets notification of Password change confirmation

wsdl:operation.name: NotificationClaimRegistration
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method sets notification of Password change confirmation

wsdl:operation.name: NotificationAccountExtraction
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method sends notification of Confirmation of Account extraction

wsdl:operation.name: NotificationCouponBought
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method sends notification of buying coupon

wsdl:operation.name: NotificationCouponTransferBetweenToken
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method sends notification of coupon's transfer between identifiers/token

wsdl:operation.name: NotificationTokenBlockedByIssuer
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method sends notification that issuing company blocked token/identifier

wsdl:operation.name: NotificationTokenBlockedByUser
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method sends notification that user blocked his token/identifier

wsdl:operation.name: NotificationPaymentAccepted
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method sends notification of incoming payment for the order

wsdl:operation.name: NotificationCancelOrderMissingPayment
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method sends notification that Order is cancelled due to missing payment

wsdl:operation.name: GetIDOLPermittedWaysForSuperZones
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method returns list of IDOL permitted ways for super zones and returns result.

wsdl:operation.name: GetIDOLTariffZoneExemptions
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method returns IDOL tariff zone exemptions (zone ways) delimited by ';' and returns result.

wsdl:operation.name: GetIDOLBusStops
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method returns IDOL Bus stops and returns result.

wsdl:operation.name: GetIDOLBusStopsWithAdditionalData
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method returns IDOL Bus stops with additional data (GPS, search names) and returns result.

wsdl:operation.name: GetIDOLBusStopsWithAdditionalDataPublic
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method returns IDOL Bus stops with additional data (GPS, search names) and returns result.

wsdl:operation.name: GetIDOLZoneWayTaxes
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method returns list of allowed/non allowed ways between IDOL zones and their tax rate and returns result.

wsdl:operation.name: GetIDOLZones
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method returns IDOL Zones and returns result.

wsdl:operation.name: GetIDOLSuperZones
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: The method returns IDOL Super zones and returns result.
